entries.title: Genesis 25:1
segments: Then again Abraham took a wife, and her name was Keturah.

entries.title: Genesis 25:2
segments: And she bore him Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah.

entries.title: Genesis 25:3
segments: And Jokshan fathered Sheba and Dedan. And the sons of Dedan were Asshurim and Letushim and Leummim.

entries.title: Genesis 25:4
segments: And the sons of Midian: Ephah and Epher and Hanoch and Abida and Eldaah. All these [were] the sons of Keturah.

entries.title: Genesis 25:5
segments: And Abraham gave all that he had to Isaac.

entries.title: Genesis 25:6
segments: But to the sons of the concubines which Abraham had, Abraham gave gifts. And he sent them away from Isaac his son while he still lived, eastward to the east country.

entries.title: Genesis 25:7
segments: And these [are] the days of the years of Abraham's life, which he lived: a hundred seventy-five years.

entries.title: Genesis 25:8
segments: And Abraham expired and died in a good old age, old and satisfied. And he was gathered to his people.

entries.title: Genesis 25:9
segments: And his sons Isaac and Ishmael buried him in the cave of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron the son of Zohar the Hittite, which [is] before Mamre,

entries.title: Genesis 25:10
segments: the field which Abraham bought from the sons of Heth. Abraham and Sarah his wife were buried there.

entries.title: Genesis 25:11
segments: And after the death of Abraham, it happened that God blessed his son Isaac. And Isaac lived by The Well of the Living One, My Beholder.

entries.title: Genesis 25:12
segments: And these [are] the generations of Ishmael, Abraham's son, whom Hagar the Egyptian, Sarah's handmaid, bore to Abraham.

entries.title: Genesis 25:13
segments: And these [are] the names of the sons of Ishmael, by their names, according to their generations. The first-born of Ishmael was Nebajoth; and Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,

entries.title: Genesis 25:14
segments: and Mishma, and Dumah, and Massa,

entries.title: Genesis 25:15
segments: Hadad, and Tema and Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah.

entries.title: Genesis 25:16
segments: These [were] the sons of Ishmael, and these [were] their names, by their towns and by their settlements; [twelve] chiefs according to their nations.

entries.title: Genesis 25:17
segments: And these [were] the years of the life of Ishmael, a hundred thirty-seven years. And he expired and died, and was gathered to his people.

entries.title: Genesis 25:18
segments: And they lived from Havilah to Shur, which [is] before Egypt, [as] you go toward Assyria. And he died in the presence of all his brothers.

entries.title: Genesis 25:19
segments: And these [were] the generations of Isaac, Abraham's son. Abraham fathered Isaac.

entries.title: Genesis 25:20
segments: And Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah to wife, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Padan-aram, the sister of Laban the Syrian.

entries.title: Genesis 25:21
segments: And Isaac prayed to the LORD for his wife, because she [was] barren. And the LORD heard him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.

entries.title: Genesis 25:22
segments: And the sons struggled together within her. And she said, If [it is] so, why [am] I this way? And she went to inquire of the LORD.

entries.title: Genesis 25:23
segments: And the LORD said to her, Two nations [are] in your womb, and two kinds of people shall be separated from your bowels. And the one people shall be stronger than the other people, the older shall serve the younger.

entries.title: Genesis 25:24
segments: And when her days to be delivered were fulfilled, behold, twins [were] in her womb!

entries.title: Genesis 25:25
segments: And the first came out red, all over like a hairy garment. And they called his name Esau.

entries.title: Genesis 25:26
segments: And after that his brother came out, and his hand took hold on Esau's heel. And his name was called Jacob. And Isaac [was] sixty years old when she bore them.

entries.title: Genesis 25:27
segments: And the boys grew. And Esau was a man knowing hunting, and Jacob was a simple man, living in tents.

entries.title: Genesis 25:28
segments: And Isaac loved Esau, for game was in [his] mouth. But Rebekah loved Jacob.

entries.title: Genesis 25:29
segments: And Jacob boiled soup. And Esau came from the field, and he was faint.

entries.title: Genesis 25:30
segments: And Esau said to Jacob, I beg you, Let me eat of the red, this red [soup], for I am faint. Therefore his name was called Edom.

entries.title: Genesis 25:31
segments: And Jacob said, Sell me your birthright today.

entries.title: Genesis 25:32
segments: And Esau said, Behold, I [am] at the point of dying, and what [profit shall] this birthright be to me?

entries.title: Genesis 25:33
segments: And Jacob said, Swear to me this day. And he swore to him, and he sold his birthright to Jacob.

entries.title: Genesis 25:34
segments: Then Jacob gave Esau bread and soup of lentils. And he ate and drank, and rose up and went his way. And Esau despised [his] birthright.
